brand.name: Dhvani
brand.niche: Digital marketing for concerts, premium Indian brands, and showrooms
brand.vibe: Bold editorial, classy, dynamic, strong typography, generous spacing, agency feel

scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-[1.1] font-bold
scale.h2: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl tracking-tight leading-[1.1] font-semibold
scale.overline: text-xs sm:text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-bold text-[#D4AF37]

layout_spacing.philosophy: Generous Spacing (Tailwind Scale 2-3x typical). Containers with borders must have internal padding (p-8).

header.style: Glassmorphism sticky header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#FDFBF7]/80 border-b border-[#0A192F]/10). Logo on left, nav links center, 'Contact Us' button right.
header.instructions: Ensure it overlays hero elegantly without blocking content.

hero.style: Editorial split layout or asymmetrical text. Massive serif 'Amplify. Engage. Succeed.' tagline. Image masked in an arch or sharp rectangle with a subtle gold accent.
hero.instructions: Do not just center everything. Create tension. No heavy black overlay.

services_bento.style: Tetris grid layout (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4). Services: SEM, SMM, SEO, Website Designing. Sharp edges or very subtle rounded corners.
services_bento.instructions: Use minimalistic cards. Off-white backgrounds, navy text, hover state reveals gold border or gold text change.

portfolio_gallery.style: Magazine-like grid or horizontal scroll. Large photography, thin 1px borders, generous whitespace.
portfolio_gallery.instructions: Projects: Sid Sriram/Jubin Nautiyal concert ads, Kavitha Gutta bridal ads, Car care showroom Google ads.

contact_form.style: Minimalist editorial form. Use border-b inputs only (no boxes). Large navy or gold submit button.
contact_form.instructions: Fields: Name, Email, Phone, Message. Must integrate with backend (MongoDB).

floating_whatsapp.style: Fixed bottom right. Circular button with WhatsApp icon, styled in brand colors or subtle green.

motion.hover: Subtle translate-y-1 on cards, text color transitions on links, scale-105 on portfolio images.
motion.entry: Staggered fade-up on scroll for sections.

hero_concert.alt: Night concert scene with audience, stage, and colorful lighting effects.
hero_concert.placement: Hero section visual or Background (if background, use light opacity)

portfolio_concert.placement: Portfolio - Concert Ads (Sid Sriram, Atif Aslam, etc.)

portfolio_bridal.alt: Bridal fashion design in red and gold sari
portfolio_bridal.placement: Portfolio - Kavitha Gutta Bridal Meta Ads

portfolio_car.alt: Collection of luxury cars in a showroom
portfolio_car.placement: Portfolio - Car Care Showroom Google Ads

specific_instructions_for_main_agent: Build the UI focusing on a bold editorial aesthetic. Use 'Playfair Display' for main headings and 'Outfit' for body.
The required sections are: Welcome (Hero), About Us, Our Vision, Our Mission, Our Service, Our Work Reference, Contact Us.
Contact Details to show: +919059294740, anushas2504@gmail.com, Vijayawada.
Implement a working Contact Us form that saves to MongoDB.
Create an '/admin' view to see the submitted leads from the database.
Add a Floating WhatsApp button linked to +919059294740.
All interactive elements MUST include 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., data-testid='contact-submit-button').
Use Phosphor Icons or Lucide React for UI adornments (WhatsApp, email, phone icons, arrow icons).
Ensure generous spacing (py-24 or py-32) between sections.
